notes: Regional site overlay (ADR 0042) for the sacred grove (hiis) in May 1343: old oaks, lindens and ash on a low rise, cup-marked offering stones under them, a spring at the foot of the rise by the river, a meadow below and spruce and birch forest round it. No human building stands here.

Invented composite (docs/LOCATIONS/sacred_grove.md, history/dossiers/folklore/harju-hiis-sites-within-walk-1343.md): sacred groves are attested, this one is not. The terrain is EU-DEM at Kostivere (Joelahtme parish), a representative karst rise by the Joelahtme river south-east of Reval, chosen for the game; it claims nothing about Kostivere. Coordinates are metres from that origin, x east, y south.

The river course is the OSM Joelahtme joegi (way 218280416), simplified; modern settlement, industry and ditches are not used. Points of interest of kind holy_oak, offering_stone, spring, campfire, torch, leanto and boundary_cairn are dressed by the site script (scenes/world/sites/hinterland_site.gd) with the models of tools/assets/build_sacred_grove_props.py; `clear_m` keeps the tree fill off them (R-1660).
